factorRatings.note: Seattle Met profiled the SoDo operation's 100%-naturally-leavened, self-milled sourdough crust and flash-freeze process; its own press page compiles Seattle Times praise for a 'crackle-crisp crust' with 'deep, tomato flavor' plus King 5 features and an endorsement from J. Kenji López-Alt, unusual sustained coverage for a take-home frozen pie ($12.50-22).

The Infatuation scored it 5.8/10 ('not recommended'), calling the crust thin, dry and crunchy despite creative pies like pineapple-chorizo and egg yolk-guanciale; the amaro-forward, jazz-bar-themed cocktail program and the banana-date cake drew the praise the pizza itself didn't.
